title: 第二课 · 你身体好吗
subtitle: Lesson 2 — 你身体好吗 · How is your health? (textbook + workbook)

items.en: How are your father and mother?

items.zh: 李老师：你早！你身体好吗？
items.py: Lǐ lǎoshī: Nǐ zǎo! Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma?
items.en: Teacher Li: Morning! How is your health?

items.py: Xuésheng: Hěn hǎo, xièxie. Nín ne?
items.en: Student: Very well, thanks. And you?

items.zh: 李老师：也很好。你忙不忙？
items.py: Lǐ lǎoshī: Yě hěn hǎo. Nǐ máng bù máng?
items.en: Teacher Li: Also fine. Are you busy?

items.zh: 老师：你好！你爸爸、妈妈好吗？
items.py: Lǎoshī: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ bàba, māma hǎo ma?
items.en: Teacher: Hello! How are your parents?

items.py: Mǎlì: Tāmen dōu hěn hǎo, xièxie.
items.en: Mary: They are all fine, thanks.

items.py: Lǎoshī: Nǐ gēge, dìdi hǎo ma?
Mǎlì: Tāmen yě dōu hěn hǎo.
items.en: Mary: They are also all fine.
Good morning! — A greeting used specifically in the morning. Short for 你早上好.
Goodbye! — Literally 'see again'. Used as a parting greeting in any situation.
Are you busy? (affirmative-negative question: adj + 不 + adj)
Is he coming? (verb + 不 + verb question)
Not too busy. (不太 = not very)
I'm not busy either. (也 + 不 = not...either)
None of them are busy. (都 + 不 = none)

items.py: Nǐ shēntǐ hǎo ma? —— Hěn hǎo.
Nǐ gōngzuò máng bù máng? —— Bú tài máng.
items.en: Is work busy? —— Not too busy.

items.py: Nǐ bàba máng bù máng? —— Tā hěn máng.
items.en: Is your father busy? —— He's very busy.

items.py: Nǐ māma hǎo ma? —— Tā hěn hǎo.
items.en: How is your mother? —— She's very well.

items.zh: 老师忙不忙？——老师不太忙。
items.py: Lǎoshī máng bù máng? —— Lǎoshī bú tài máng.
items.en: Is teacher busy? —— Teacher is not too busy.

items.py: Nǐ hǎo ma? —— Wǒ hěn hǎo.
Wǒ gēge, dìdi míngnián dōu lái.
items.en: My brothers are all coming next year.

items.zh: 他爸爸、妈妈身体不太好。
items.py: Tā bàba, māma shēntǐ bú tài hǎo.
items.en: His parents' health is not so good.
